title: Motorbike with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="72" r="14" fill="#2b2b5e"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="72" r="10" fill="#4a4a8a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="72" r="4" fill="#8a8ad0"/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="14" fill="#2b2b5e"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="10" fill="#4a4a8a"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="4" fill="#8a8ad0"/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <rect x="30" y="62" width="16" height="6" rx="3" fill="#a0a0c0"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="65" r="3" fill="#c8c8e8"/>
  <!-- body/fairing -->
  <path d="M22 56 Q22 44 34 44 L58 44 Q72 44 74 56 L74 64 L26 64 Z" fill="#ff5a5a"/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <path d="M30 44 Q30 38 38 38 L52 38 Q58 38 58 44 Z" fill="#3a3a7a"/>
  <!-- fuel tank -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#ff8080"/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#fff6c0"/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <path d="M68 44 L72 36 L80 36" fill="none" stroke="#c0c0e0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- smiley face on the tank -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="42" r="1.8" fill="#3a1a1a"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="42" r="1.8" fill="#3a1a1a"/>
  <path d="M42 46 Q49 51 56 46" fill="none" stroke="#3a1a1a" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little mirrors -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="32" r="2.5" fill="#d0d0f0"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="34" x2="78" y2="37" stroke="#d0d0f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>
